title: Bamboo Can Grow Almost a Metre in a Single Day

scenes.text: Bamboo can grow almost a metre in a single day.
An inch and a half every hour. Film it and watch it rise.
Guinness lists it as the fastest growing plant: up to 91 centimetres a day.
And it's not a tree. It's a grass. The tallest reach 30 metres, ten storeys high.
Each stalk comes up at full width, then every hollow segment stretches at once, like a telescope.
Full height in one season, then it never grows taller. Almost a metre a day.

description:
Some bamboo species can grow up to 91 centimetres in a single day, which makes bamboo the fastest growing plant on Earth according to Guinness World Records.
Bamboo is a grass, not a tree. Each new stalk emerges from the ground at its full thickness and reaches its full height in a single growing season, as its hollow segments elongate; the tallest species pass 30 metres.
What's the fastest thing you've ever seen grow in your own garden?
first_comment: Japanese giant timber bamboo has been measured growing 120 centimetres in one day. Which would you rather have in your garden: bamboo that grows a metre a day, or a tree that lives a thousand years?
